class.name: OcgGeom2dConic
class.brief_description: The abstract class Conic describes the common behavior of conic curves in 2D space and, in particular, their general characteristics. The Geom2d package provides four specific classes of conics: Geom2d_Circle, Geom2d_Ellipse, Geom2d_Hyperbola and Geom2d_Parabola. A conic is positioned in the plane with a coordinate system (gp_Ax22d object), where the origin is the center of the conic (or the apex in case of a parabola). This coordinate system is the local coordinate system of the conic. It gives the conic an explicit orientation, determining the direction in which the parameter increases along the conic. The "X Axis" of the local coordinate system also defines the origin of the parameter of the conic.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Modifies this conic, redefining its local coordinate system partially, by assigning theA as its axis

method.name: SetXAxis
method.description: Assigns the origin and unit vector of axis theA to the origin of the local coordinate system of this conic and X Direction. The other unit vector of the local coordinate system of this conic is recomputed normal to theA, without changing the orientation of the local coordinate system (right-handed or left-handed).

method.name: SetYAxis
method.description: Assigns the origin and unit vector of axis theA to the origin of the local coordinate system of this conic and Y Direction. The other unit vector of the local coordinate system of this conic is recomputed normal to theA, without changing the orientation of the local coordinate system (right-handed or left-handed).

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Modifies this conic, redefining its local coordinate system partially, by assigning theP as its origin.

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Returns the "XAxis" of the conic. This axis defines the origin of parametrization of the conic. This axis and the "Yaxis" define the local coordinate system of the conic. -C++: return const&

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Returns the "YAxis" of the conic. The "YAxis" is perpendicular to the "Xaxis".

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the location point of the conic. For the circle, the ellipse and the hyperbola it is the center of the conic. For the parabola it is the vertex of the parabola.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the local coordinates system of the conic.

method.name: Reverse
method.description: Reverses the direction of parameterization of <me>. The local coordinate system of the conic is modified.

method.name: Continuity
method.description: Returns GeomAbs_CN which is the global continuity of any conic.

method.name: IsCN
method.description: Returns True, the order of continuity of a conic is infinite.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
